newsitem.title: UK: Shorts,Hughes sign transatlantic cooperation accor.
newsitem.headline: Shorts,Hughes sign transatlantic cooperation accor.

text.p: Shorts Missile Systems Ltd (SMS) and Hughes UK Ltd said on Tuesday that they had signed a transatlantic cooperation agreement.
Under the terms of the agreement, SMS has joined with Hughes to bid for all potential Beyond Visual Range Air-to-Air Missile programmes in international markets, SMS said in a statement.
"It potentially provides Shorts with access and involvement in other Hughes programmes," SMS said, adding it could also provide Shorts with access to the U.S. market.
SMS is a joint venture between Belfast-based Shorts Brothers Plc, a subsidiary of Canada's Bombardier Inc, and Thomson-CSF of France.
